quotes.text: Customize your checkout page's colors, fonts, shapes, and more.
This article has multiple variants. Fetch one of the following URLs to view specific content for your use case:

old_evidence.text: By default, we apply the custom branding set in the Dashboard to your Checkout Sessions. If you omit a field in `branding_settings`, Checkout applies the default value from the Dashboard.

Invoices for [subscriptions](https://docs.stripe.com/receipts.md#invoice-and-subscription-payment-receipts) and invoices for [one-time payments](https://docs.stripe.com/payments/checkout/receipts.md?payment-ui=stripe-hosted#paid-invoices-hosted) from a Checkout Session still use the branding settings set in the Dashboard.

To override the brand settings of the connected account, set [branding_settings](https://docs.stripe.com/api/checkout/sessions/create.md#create_checkout_session-branding_settings) when you create the Checkout Session.
The following table lists unsupported locales for each font.

findings: The complete November capture is a purpose sentence plus an index with two URLs (new raw lines 5-14). It does not supply branding_settings fields, Connect behavior, logo/icon precedence, invoice branding, or font-locale compatibility. The diff's wholesale removal of old details (diff lines 3-209) reflects a capture/variant representation shift and does not establish deprecation.

The old capture, fetched April 20, separately describes Hosted page and Embedded page variants (old raw lines 8-10, 116-118). The November links are labeled Full page with ui=full-page and Embedded form with ui=checkout-form (new raw lines 13-14). The labels and query parameters differ; without the linked variant bodies, the exact mapping to old hosted/embedded_page behavior is unresolved. Navigation links should not be treated as current behavioral authority.

For the old hosted Checkout Session path, Dashboard branding supplies defaults, per-Session branding_settings can override fields, logo/icon precedence affects display versus favicon, and invoices from a Checkout Session still use Dashboard branding (old raw lines 12-37, 44-69). Connect branding depends on connected-account destination charges with on_behalf_of or platform direct charges; a Session branding_settings override is available in that described path (old raw lines 21-23, 71-73).

For the old embedded_page path, the guide illustrates color/font/shape/display_name fields in a Checkout Session example (old raw lines 120-163) and repeats Connect, invoice and font-locale qualifications (old raw lines 166-207). The old page never states a categorical no-logo or only-these-fields constraint for embedded Checkout.

The existing summary's lines 19 and 24-32 mark icon/logo unavailable and embedded fields exclusive, promoting example omission into a support prohibition. Its line 18 says 'Invoices always use Dashboard branding' without the old raw's narrower 'invoices for subscriptions and one-time payments from a Checkout Session' scope (old raw lines 37, 139). These are baseline summary accuracy defects independent of the November index change.

The current source only cites old raw at lines 4-7 and 62-64. Its November update should add the index raw as provenance, preserve April 20 guide assertions with date and UI qualifier, and avoid equating ui=checkout-form with old payment-ui=embedded-form. The root-to-provider-to-main-concept route is wiki/index.md lines 5-7, wiki/stripe-index.md lines 31-35, and wiki/concepts/stripe-checkout.md lines 12-29 and 248-255.
substantive_changes: No new customization behavior or restriction is established by the November body; it changes the landing capture into a two-link variant index (new raw lines 9-14; old raw lines 8-207).

The visible navigation labels and query parameters now say Full page/ui=full-page and Embedded form/ui=checkout-form (new raw lines 13-14) instead of the old captured Hosted page/payment-ui=stripe-hosted and Embedded page/payment-ui=embedded-form (old raw lines 8-10, 116-118). This is a route/selection change, not proof of equivalent or changed variant behavior.
historical_claims_to_preserve: Keep April 20 hosted Checkout Dashboard and per-Session branding_settings behavior, field inheritance and logo/icon/favicon precedence dated and path-scoped (old raw lines 12-37, 44-69).

Keep Connect behavior conditional on destination charges with on_behalf_of or platform direct charges, plus Session override and Accounts API route for connected accounts lacking full Dashboard access (old raw lines 21-23, 71-73, 126-128, 166-168).
Keep the Checkout Session invoice-branding warning with its source scope, and the business-name/network-rule caution (old raw lines 37, 75-81, 139, 170-174).

Keep April 20 font-locale fallback and 24-row unsupported-locale table as historical variant detail, including locale auto selection from browser settings (old raw lines 83-114, 176-207). The November index does not revalidate every row.
Keep the old embedded_page example's ui_mode, branding fields and return_url as an illustration, not a complete field schema or payment-success proof (old raw lines 130-164).
conflicts: Current source lines 19, 24-32 and 34 label embedded logo/icon unsupported, but old raw lines 130-163 show only an example omitting those fields; no old raw sentence or November raw line establishes a prohibition.
Current source line 18 generalizes invoice branding beyond old raw lines 37 and 139, which specifically concern invoices from a Checkout Session.

The old embedded_page route (old raw lines 116-118) and November checkout-form route (new raw line 14) have different names and parameters; any reciprocal route calling them identical needs explicit qualification.
unresolved_questions: What fields, defaults, Connect behavior and font support the November Full page and Embedded form variants actually specify is unresolved because their linked bodies were not pinned (new raw lines 11-14).

Whether ui=checkout-form is the successor to old payment-ui=embedded-form, a distinct Checkout Form surface, or merely a revised docs selector is unresolved from the two base captures (old raw lines 116-118; new raw line 14).

findings: Add November two-route index as navigation, with old April 20 hosted/embedded details retained and dated (new raw lines 9-14; old raw lines 8-207; current source lines 4-7, 62-64).
Remove or qualify the categorical embedded logo/icon absence in current source lines 19, 24-32, 34; old raw lines 130-163 are an example, not a complete support matrix.
Scope invoice branding to invoices from a Checkout Session as in old raw lines 37 and 139, narrowing current source line 18.
conflicts: Old embedded page and new Embedded form use different selectors (old raw lines 116-118; new raw line 14), so their identity is not established.
Current source's no-logo embedded claim is unsupported by old raw example and absent from new index.
source_assessments.reason: The November capture changes only routing/presentation, but the old summary independently overclaims embedded logo exclusion and invoice scope. A dated source correction and index route are necessary.

answers.Q1: For https://docs.stripe.com/payments/checkout/customization/appearance, the complete November capture establishes the purpose of changing Checkout page colors, fonts and shapes and provides Full page and Embedded form variant URLs, but no fields, prerequisites, account or Session rules, or payment outcomes (new raw lines 5-14). The April 20 capture details Dashboard defaults, Checkout Session branding_settings overrides, conditional Connect account branding, logo/icon display and favicon choices, invoice branding for invoices from a Checkout Session, and locale-specific font fallback (old raw lines 12-37, 71-87, 120-180). source-stripe-checkout-appearance.md describes those old details at current source lines 11-54 but needs November navigation and correction of unsupported embedded no-logo and overbroad invoice claims.
answers.Q2: For https://docs.stripe.com/payments/checkout/customization/appearance, the apparent deletion of old details is an index/presentation shift: the new capture links Full page/ui=full-page and Embedded form/ui=checkout-form (new raw lines 9-14), whereas the old capture included Hosted page/payment-ui=stripe-hosted and Embedded page/payment-ui=embedded-form bodies (old raw lines 8-10 and 116-118). No linked November variant was read, so source-stripe-checkout-appearance.md must retain April 20 behavior as dated, UI-scoped history; it must not claim those routes are identical. Its embedded logo prohibition and generic invoice-always wording exceed old evidence (old raw lines 27-37, 130-163; current source lines 18-34). Connect charges, Dashboard fallback, locale/font compatibility, and Checkout Session versus invoice branding remain qualified; creating a branded Session or returning from it proves no payment success.
